summary: Arcadeia is a self‑hosted media library that creates animated video previews using ffmpeg and offers a lightweight web UI. It runs as a CLI tool and a web interface without requiring an API key. It targets users who want a personal media catalog with visual previews, but its tiny community and lack of distinguishing features make it a modest alternative to established platforms like Plex or Jellyfin. The only clear strength is its recent activity, while the main drawback is minimal adoption and scarce documentation.

github.description: Arcadeia is an open-source, self-hosted photo and video library. Find clips with animated previews, search filenames and descriptions, and make spoken words searchable with optional local transcription. Connect network storage, upload media with drag and drop, and watch videos in your browser.

negative_signals: Demo site unavailable and lacks visual preview
